content: actor_store/car.rs uses CarWriter::with_roots()/write_block()/finish(). proto-blue exposes free fns: blocks_to_car(root, &BlockMap) and read_car(data) -> (Vec<Cid>, BlockMap). Need to convert (cid_str, bytes) tuples into BlockMap entries, parse strings into proto_blue::lex_data::Cid via from_string, and rewrite the export_repo_to_car/blocks_to_car/export_record_to_car helpers. Also update the existing test that uses CarReader to use read_car.
